CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsNumericDate

Returns YES if the value is a real number, or a date/time object, that KoldFusion can treat as a date. Internally a date is a number of days since December 30, 1899, with the time of day as the fraction.

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsNumericDate(number)

Parameters

number
Any value.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Date strings such as "12/31/1999" return NO here; IsDate is the function for strings. Date/time objects returned by Now or CreateDate return YES because they are stored as numbers. Date arithmetic works on these numbers directly: Now() + 1 is this time tomorrow.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Millennium = CreateDate(2000, 1, 1)>
<CFSET Eve = Millennium - 1>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Value</TH><TH>IsNumericDate</TH><TH>IsDate</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>Millennium = CreateDate(2000, 1, 1)</TD><TD>#IsNumericDate(Millennium)#</TD><TD>#IsDate(Millennium)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Eve = Millennium - 1 = #Eve#</TD><TD>#IsNumericDate(Eve)#</TD><TD>#IsDate(Eve)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>"12/31/1999"</TD><TD>#IsNumericDate("12/31/1999")#</TD><TD>#IsDate("12/31/1999")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>"Y2K"</TD><TD>#IsNumericDate("Y2K")#</TD><TD>#IsDate("Y2K")#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>Day #Eve# is #DateFormat(Eve, "dddd, mmmm d, yyyy")#. Party like it's day #Eve#!</CFOUTPUT>

See also
